name: Tomato and Basil Soup
instructions: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil over medium heat until soft but not coloured.
Add the garlic and the basil stalks and cook for one more minute.
Tip in the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer for 25 minutes.
Blend until completely smooth, adding a little hot water if it is too thick.
Stir in the cream and the basil leaves and warm through without boiling.
Season with salt and black pepper and serve with buttered toast.
